# Preface {.unnumbered}

This book is about treating artificial intelligence as an infrastructure:
a layer that other software depends on, that must stay up, stay correct,
stay affordable, and stay observable. We focus on three load-bearing
activities, inference, training, and evaluation, and we look at each one
twice.

The first pass is engineering. How do you serve a model so it answers
under load without falling over? How do you run a training job that
finishes, resumes after a node dies, and produces a checkpoint you trust?
How do you measure quality in a way that survives contact with a real
product? These are systems questions, and we answer them with systems
tools: throughput, latency, cost, reliability, reproducibility.

The second pass is theory. Once you have built the systems, the natural
next question is why they behave the way they do. Why does batching help
until it does not? Why does a learning rate schedule shaped one way beat
another? What does an evaluation number actually estimate, and when is it
lying to you? Here we trade dashboards for derivations.

## How this book is organized

- **Part I, Engineering Practices.** Inference, training, and evaluation
  as dependable production systems.
- **Part II, Theoretical Foundations.** The mathematics and principles
  that explain the behavior Part I asks you to operate.

You can read Part I on its own as a practitioner's guide. You can read
Part II on its own if you already run these systems and want the model
behind the dials. Read both, in order, for the full arc from practice to
principle.

## Who this is for

Engineers who deploy and operate AI systems, and researchers who want to
see how their theory lands in production. We assume comfort with one
programming language, basic probability and linear algebra, and the
ordinary tools of running software in production.

## Conventions

Code, configuration, and commands appear in monospace. Mathematical claims
are stated precisely and, where it helps, derived. Diagrams use Mermaid.
Each chapter opens with what you will be able to do or explain by the end.

::: {.callout-note}
This book is a work in progress. Chapters carry outlines and open
questions marked as `TODO` while drafting proceeds.
:::
